assessment: This manuscript reports an important, previously unappreciated, non-developmental role for the guidance cue netrin-1 in midbrain physiology and related behavior in adult animals. Using multiple experimental tools in adult mice, the study convincingly shows that netrin-1 within midbrain dopamine and GABA neurons is necessary to maintain dopamine excitatory tone and plays a role in motivated and anxiety-like behavior. This paper will be of interest to neuroscientists studying dopamine function and/or motivated behavior and those interested in ways that neurodevelopmental genes can continue to play a role in neuronal function and behavior into adulthood.
